assertion: the run names one agreed public seam and one observable behaviour before writing the test
feature work proceeds as one vertical slice: one test, one minimum implementation, then the next acceptance criterion
the red output is read and rejected when it proves setup, imports, credentials, or environment instead of missing behaviour
red_check records RED and GREEN for the same unchanged test file and verify exits zero; the verify branch table lives in tests/fixtures/verify_casi.json and is proved by the pytest file
an existing fix is mutated only through an isolated reversible path; generic stash instructions are not used

frozen tests fail on base on behaviour (assertion, or an exception production raises; never import, placeholder, unbound name or attribute missing from a module), pass on solution and private refactor, kill every public-behaviour mutant and remain byte-identical; all pinned negative controls are WEAK with the expected outcome reason

every test is written under the rules of the section How tests are written, read before the test list: it names the break it catches, derives its oracle without the code under test, and keeps doubles to external or slow boundaries without asserting on them

after the unchanged-test RED/GREEN receipt verifies, the repo-authoritative relevant regression suite is recorded in the same receipt and final verify passes before review or deploy handoff; the suite-cmd branches are proved by the pytest file over tests/fixtures/verify_casi.json

a requested test that asserts a name, a path, a file's text, message wording or a config value is refused as written, and the run writes in its place a test that runs the code through its public seam and asserts its output, side effect or exit code
when the requested test pinned a configuration value, the replacement hands the unit its own setting values, so editing the shipped configuration file cannot turn the test red

a test that would depend on the wall clock, ordering, network or shared state is made deterministic at the public seam: the time, order or randomness is passed in by the caller, changing the production signature when needed, never by patching a name inside the module under test

a request for more unit tests so that a whole-flow production break cannot recur is answered with an integration or real-testing check of that flow as the regression guard; unit tests are written only for a unit whose behaviour is being designed or changed
each test proves one behaviour and asserts only what proves it; an assertion already made by another test, or about another behaviour, is dropped
